# v1.4.1 - Better installs and release pages

### What's Changed

This release ships no plugin changes: the quest automation is exactly the state of 1.4.0. What changed is how releases are published, what the download contains, and which tooling the build uses.

- **Install instructions on every release**: the steps are now right in the release body (unzip into `src/userplugins/`, rebuild, reload) instead of only in the README
- **Cleaner download**: the archive contains the plugin as `Questcord/` instead of `Questcord-v1.4.1/`, so it can be unzipped straight into `src/userplugins/` without renaming anything
- **Correct compare links**: the "Full Changelog" line is generated, so it always points from the previous release to this one
- **Notes live in the repo**: release notes are written as `.github/releases/vX.Y.Z.md` and reviewed with the pull request, with the changelog section or a grouped commit list as a fallback
- **Prereleases**: tags like `v1.5.0-rc.1` publish as a prerelease and never replace the "Latest" release
- Dependency updates: `@vitest/coverage-v8` 5.0.4 and `typescript-eslint` 8.71.2 (dev only, the plugin ships no runtime dependencies)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zpt0/Questcord/compare/v1.4.0...v1.4.1
